question: A boat can travel at a speed of 15.5 km/h in still water. If speed of the stream is 4.5 km/h, then how much time will it take to go 76 km downstream and 104.5 km upstream?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Downstream Speed = 15.5 + 4.5 = 20 km/h

Upstream Speed = 15.5 − 4.5 = 11 km/h

Total Time = (76 ÷ 20) + (104.5 ÷ 11)

Total Time = 3.8 + 9.5 = 13.3 hours

13.3 hours = 13 hours and (0.3 × 60) minutes = 13 hours 18 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 hours 18 minutes.**
